description: On the bed in front of the hands are toy sandwich pieces: two bread slices, a green plate, lettuce, tomato and onion rings, a pink deli slice, bacon strips, a cheese square, and a yellow “sauce” splat. The right hand lifts one bread slice and places it onto the green plate, then stacks lettuce, tomato with onion rings, the pink slice, bacon, cheese, and the yellow sauce on top, while the left hand mostly rests nearby; finally, the right hand picks up the second bread slice and moves it over the stack to close the sandwich.
